analysis: Espino delivered a flawless defensive performance, winning 100% of his aerial duels and registering a perfect rating in tackles, which allowed Rayo Vallecano to maintain structural integrity against physical pressure. His ability to read the game is evident in his interception work, effectively cutting off passing lanes before they developed. However, his limited involvement in progressive passing (2.6 rating) highlights a conservative role focused purely on containment rather than ball progression. With no fouls or disciplinary issues, he provided a stable, error-free 90 minutes that anchored the backline without disrupting team rhythm.
